metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly jackets for your team or event. Durable, breathable, and perfect for screen printing. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Cotton poly jackets combine the softness of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester, making them a practical choice for uniforms, team apparel, or promotional giveaways. The blend holds vibrant screen-printed logos well and withstands repeated washing without fading. Whether you need youth sizes for a school event or adult jackets for a corporate team, these jackets offer comfort and long-lasting performance for any climate.
